item.title: 【Cinema Center】MOVIE - When Harry Met Sally... (1989) 1080p BluRay AAC 2.0 x265-DJSF [4.49 GB]
item.description:
In 1977, college graduates Harry Burns (Billy Crystal) and Sally Albright (Meg Ryan) share a contentious car ride from Chicago to New York, during which they argue about whether men and women can ever truly be strictly platonic friends. Ten years later, Harry and Sally meet again at a bookstore, and in the company of their respective best friends, Jess (Bruno Kirby) and Marie (Carrie Fisher), attempt to stay friends without sex becoming an issue between them.
Click to expand...
Source used: When Harry Met Sally 1989 1080p BluRay REMUX AVC FLAC 2.0-DURO

By request. Since Rob Reiner and his wife has passed away last week (screw his son Nick for murdering him), I thought I wanna share this amazing romcom here. This was an encode I did last year but since it was a "REPACK" (as I already shared it to the Snahp forum) for the superior original Stereo track coming from the Laserdisc (which is the default audio track alongside the 5.1 surround upmix and 2 audio commentary tracks).

This is the 4K remaster of the 2023 Capelight Pictures Blu-ray from Germany (with the accurate colour palette that was presented on the 2001 MGM DVD and 2011 MGM Blu-ray), don't bother with the 2019 Shout Factory release (which has inaccurate colour palette and having too much DNR making the skins/faces tones too red-ish). It was CRF to 24 with custom slow preset. 5.1 surround audio upmix was re-encoded to Dolby Digital Plus audio at 768kb/s bitrate by using Dolby Encoding Engine, original Stereo audio mix was re-encoded to AAC at qaac -V 127 while the commentary tracks were done at qaac -V 63.
